Hi Liam — thanks for the note, and congrats on the close. Quick answers below and a couple of asks so our finance team can do the cutover cleanly.

1) Invoicing payee: Redwood requires an exact legal name and remit address on invoices. We can bill the acquiring entity as you proposed: 
   "Northbridge Logistics Holdings, Inc."
   Remit: 42 Seaport Way, Suite 320, Boston, MA 02110 (please confirm this is the address to print on the invoice).

2) Bank/remit contact: we typically route collections threads to finance@redwood.ai, but for an acquisition cutover we need a named contact and a backstop email for disputes. Please confirm the person to contact + phone.

3) Authorization: Our AP team needs one of the following to reassign payee for invoices already issued in April: a) an emailed PO addendum signed by a company officer, or b) a short signed letter on company letterhead authorizing the payee change. Please let us know which you'd prefer.

Connor (cc) will validate outstanding invoices and confirm the last invoice number we need to reissue under the new payee. Marissa will coordinate the calendar cutover to avoid duplicate remits.

If you can send the signed wiring auth + PO addendum by Monday, April 24, we can target May 1 for live processing.

Best,
